column1: # Case table for substrate/.github/workflows/pleme.yml — THE UNIVERSAL COMPOSER.
# TAB-separated: <name>
# WHAT THIS PINS. pleme.yml is a 20-job dispatcher and nothing else: one
# `validate` job plus 19 mutually-exclusive `uses:` arms, gated either on
# `inputs.family` (the ten tier-2 family composers) or on
# `inputs.family == 'direct' && inputs.target == '<one of the 9 that nest>'`.
# Its entire correctness IS the selection — exactly one arm per (family,
# target), and no arm at all for an input nobody catalogued. actionlint cannot
# see that (every expression is valid) and no unit test can (there is no code
# here), which is the same blind spot that let a green run publish nothing.
# EVERY ROW IS A COMPLETE PARTITION — run + skip together name all 20 jobs.
# That is deliberate. A dispatcher's failure mode is rarely "my arm did not
# fire"; it is "somebody else's arm fired too". A row asserting only its own
# arm would not notice a sibling whose guard lost its `inputs.family` half.
# THE FIVE BOUNDARY ROWS AT THE BOTTOM ARE THE POINT, not padding. In four of
# them ZERO arms select and only `validate` runs: an uncatalogued family, an
# empty family, a `direct` target that is really a flat leaf, an empty target.
# The dispatch surface goes completely quiet, and the ONLY thing between that
# silence and a green run that did no work is `validate`'s tatara-script
# exiting 1. This table cannot assert that exit — job selection is not step
# outcome — so it asserts the half that makes the exit load-bearing. If
# `validate` is ever softened to a warning, the silence it would expose is
# already written down here.
# PUBLISH COVERAGE. The `direct` arms reach the fleet's releasing reusables
# (cargo-release, auto-release, auto-release-min, helm-chart-release,
# release-pipeline). Do-it and don't-do-it are both asserted for each: it runs
# in exactly its own row and is expected SKIPPED in the other 23.
# No status functions appear below because no condition in pleme.yml calls one.
# Every arm is a plain equality on `inputs`, and since `validate` is
# unconditional, needs-propagation never subtracts anything — so the two
# `inputs.*` paths are the whole context, and both are declared in every row.
# `inputs.runner` is deliberately absent: it feeds `runs-on`, never an `if:`,
# so it cannot change which jobs select.
# ── the ten family arms: one row each, family target values are real leaves ──
family-rust
family-ruby
family-go
family-ansible
family-caixa
family-iac
family-helm
family-container
family-publish
family-ops
# ── the nine that nest, dispatched directly (a tier-2 hop would make the ─────
# ── reusable chain 5 deep and the run would refuse to start) ────────────────
direct-cargo-ci
direct-pre-merge-gate
direct-cargo-release
direct-helm-chart-release
# THE PREFIX PAIR. 'auto-release' and 'auto-release-min' are guarded by `==`,
# not startsWith(), so the shorter name must NOT drag the longer arm in with
# it. These two rows are the only proof of that; deleting either restores a
# defect that would look green.
direct-auto-release
direct-auto-release-min
direct-release-pipeline
direct-pleme-stack
direct-super-cache-ci-build-matrix
# A family arm is NOT target-gated: it forwards whatever `target` it was given
# to the tier-2 composer, so `rust` still selects on an empty target and the
# emptiness is caught one layer down (or by `validate`). Asserting it here
# records where the target check actually lives, so nobody "fixes" it by
# bolting a target guard onto the family arms.
family-arm-is-not-target-gated
# Catch-all: a family nobody catalogued. Zero arms select. The run is green
# unless `validate` fails it — which is exactly what `validate` is for.
unknown-family-selects-nothing
# Empty family — distinct from "unknown". A caller that computed `family` from
# an earlier step and got nothing back lands here, and it is the state most
# likely to be mistaken for a healthy no-op.
empty-family-selects-nothing
# The trap pleme.yml's own comment names: `direct` with a FLAT leaf as target.
# `cargo-auto-release` is a real, heavily-adopted reusable — it is simply not
# one of the nine that nest, so no arm matches and the whole dispatcher goes
# silent. This is the row most likely to be produced by a real caller typo.
direct-with-flat-leaf-target-selects-nothing
# `direct` with nothing to dispatch to: "detect ran and produced nothing".
direct-with-empty-target-selects-nothing
